summary: Verified new admin CMS features on /admin/settings: palette picker (6 palettes), live preview, persistence, desktop/mobile toggle, and section text edits reflecting on public homepage. All flows PASS. Palette restored to 'green' and section texts restored to defaults at end.
critical_code_review_comments: SiteSettings.jsx is ~275 lines and mixes hero image/text AI + palette + device toggle + section texts. Consider splitting into smaller subcomponents if it grows further.
ThemeApplier only fetches once on mount; if admin saves palette while a public tab is open in another window, that other tab won't re-apply until refresh (acceptable but worth noting).
seed_data_creation: None (test used temporary TEST_ values then restored defaults)
